name: Rucking
instructions: Load a rucksack or weighted vest with a manageable weight, typically 10 to 30% of body weight, and fit it snugly against your back to minimize shifting.
Walk at a brisk pace with good posture, keeping the load centered and your core braced. Use trekking poles or adjust your stride on uneven or inclined terrain.
Rucking adds resistance to ordinary walking, building leg and back strength alongside cardiovascular fitness. A 150 lb person carrying a 30 lb pack can burn over 400 calories rucking for 30 minutes.
